description: Co-founder and 54% shareholder of the École de la rénovation énergétique (éRE), a private vocational training company, declared in his HATVP declaration of interests; subject of a 2024 conflict-of-interest report by Le Monde.
Co-author with Yann Algan of the book 'L'État en mode start-up' (Eyrolles, 2017), on modernising public administration.
As an MP, member of the France-Québec, France-Senegal and France-Ukraine parliamentary friendship groups, and head of the National Assembly's delegation to local authorities and decentralisation.
